correctness.rationale: A face containing the apex is exactly an independent set of the cycle complement, giving a literal circle link. All deletion facets for n>=6 are pairwise-disjoint cycle-edge endpoint sets, the facets of the cyclic 4-polytope; thus the deletion is S3 and the inclusion S1->S3 is nullhomotopic. The cofiber is S2 vee S3 integrally. The degree-two dihedral module is the circle orientation by the natural connecting map; the degree-three module is the trivial line via the signed primitive top-cycle built from oriented disjoint edge pairs. Finite face, boundary and character checks passed for n=3..12, with homology ranks independently checked n<=10.
